# VV | MIDI Rompler

A professional web-based MIDI Rompler built with React, Tone.js, and smplr.

## Core Documentation
- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, features, and setup instructions.
- [PROJECT_STATE.md](PROJECT_STATE.md): Current architecture, tech stack, and system capabilities.

## Source Code
- [src/App.tsx](src/App.tsx): Main application component and UI state management.
- [src/audio/engine.ts](src/audio/engine.ts): Hybrid audio engine managing Tone.js samplers and smplr patches.
- [src/audio/useMidi.ts](src/audio/useMidi.ts): Custom hook for Web MIDI integration and sustain pedal logic.
- [src/components/Knob.tsx](src/components/Knob.tsx): Custom skeuomorphic knob component.
- [src/components/VUMeter.tsx](src/components/VUMeter.tsx): Real-time visual feedback for audio levels.
